post.description: Insert a batch of new App Event occurrences into the timeline. Each occurrence in the batch is immutable, and if an occurrence with the same ID already exists, the entire batch will be rejected. The batch can include occurrences from multiple event types, but all must belong to a single portal.

inputs.description: An array of AppEventOccurrence objects, each representing an individual app event occurrence to be included in the batch. This property is required.

post.description: Resolve the fully qualified name (FQN) of an App Event Type using its developer coordinates, which include the project name and developer symbol. This endpoint is used for event types managed through Projects and does not support legacy or non-migrated event types.

developerSymbol.description: The developer symbol used to identify the App Event Type. It is a string.

projectName.description: The name of the project associated with the App Event Type. It is a string.

developerSymbol.description: A string representing the developer's unique symbol or identifier within the project. This symbol is used in conjunction with the project name to resolve the fully qualified name of an App Event Type.

projectName.description: The name of the project associated with the developer. It is a string that identifies the project within the developer's scope.

fullyQualifiedName.description: A string representing the fully qualified name of the App Event Type.

404.description: There is no App Event Type for the provided coordinates. Did you provide them correctly?
